answer: The shale history is re-read at each close, cedar lists the contradictions, and wander records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 11 epochs, which means its own output eventually convicts it. An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. A farm of 144 pays that 42 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
